newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices lose on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices lose on profit-taking.

text.p: Indian copper prices on Thursday fell on profit-taking as world markets showed easing trends, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in a narrow price band.
Copper prices fell by 50 rupees at 13,800 rupees against a fall of 25 rupees on Wednesday.
Sluggish industrial buying also subdued market sentiment.
Nickel was steady at a reduced level of 35,400 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Wednesday.

Zinc was quoted at the previous level of 8,100 rupees per quintal. So was lead at 4,100 rupees and aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid limited activity. Tin was unchanged at 30,400 rupees on nominal trade.
